missions.name: Billing rows for list and form: BillingSummaryBadge, BillingAmountInput, BillingIntervalSelector
missions.objective: Implement three of the retained Billable obligations from the trait declarations as authority (no HTML exists to port): BillingSummaryBadge (list: one announced amount/currency/interval phrase), BillingAmountInput (form: major-unit editing stored as integer minor units) and BillingIntervalSelector (form: options from the billingIntervals parameter with keyboard navigation and a typed update). Give each the Sprint 185 bar: contract, shared scenarios, prop-value contracts, HTML renderer, React, Vue, token styles, readiness rows and value-level tests. Their catalog status flips through the structured-data refresh so fresh composition places them. AMENDED 2026-09-08 (check-in PS-2026-09-08-005): composer changes are bounded to two mechanisms — (1) resolving the trait parameter references named by *Parameter props (minorUnits, billingIntervals, including the object's own overrides such as Subscription's monthly/yearly) into concrete values on the placed node while preserving the authored parameter reference for attribution; (2) marking these three recipes extension-only so generic single-field fallback selection never places them, while explicit view-extension placement is retained. No other composer behavior moves, and both mechanisms are regression-pinned by the 66-schema census with a per-schema enumeration.
successCriteria: AMENDED 2026-09-08: After the structured-data refresh, design_compose Subscription/list contains BillingSummaryBadge and Subscription/form contains BillingIntervalSelector and BillingAmountInput, placed only by the view-extension path and carrying the trait field props, the authored parameter references and the resolved parameter values (Subscription: intervals exactly ['monthly','yearly'] from the object's override; minorUnits 100); both schemas generate green at profile=build in react and vue; the other 64 fresh schemas and the Subscription/workflow schema are unchanged except where a trait declares the same three IDs (enumerated per schema by object, context and trait); a spec proves generic single-field fallback selection never places any of the three (Subscription/detail composes without them, and an object with an amount-like field and no Billable trait composes without them); workflow generation stays green with no OODS-V007
